title: Pack catalogs
lead: Template packs beyond the ones built into the image: from a git repository or an archive. New versions appear in the project wizard without a rebuild or restart.

sources.title: Sources
sources.lead: Check first: the Studio fetches the revision and shows which versions will appear. Apply puts exactly the checked revision into the catalog.
sources.emptyLead: Connect a packs repository or upload an archive.

source.disabledHint: The source packs are hidden from the project wizard. Versions stay for existing projects.
source.trackingHint: Once a day the Studio checks the source and applies new released versions.
source.noPacks: No packs in the catalog yet: check and apply the source.

pack.versionHiddenHint: The version is there for existing projects, but the wizard does not offer it.

others.title: Other catalog packs
others.lead: Built into the image and left from removed sources. They are read-only here.

add.title: Add source
add.lead: After adding, check and apply the source: until then its packs do not appear in the wizard.
add.label: Name
add.labelHint: How the source is named in the list. Empty: from the address or file name.
add.packsPathGitHint: Path to the packs folder from the repository root.
add.packsPathArchiveHint: Path to the packs folder inside the archive. Empty: the archive root.
add.refHint: Empty: the default branch. A tag is safer: its content does not change.
add.credentialEmpty: You have no git access for this address. Add one under Git access in the settings.
add.serviceEmpty: No service access yet. Add it in the Template Studio section.
add.replaceBuiltinHint: A pack with the same id as a built-in one replaces it in the wizard. Without the check box such a pack is not connected.
add.trackHint: The Studio checks the source by itself and applies new released versions when nothing blocks them.
add.fileTooLarge: The file is larger than {{size}}: such an archive is refused.

edit.title: Edit “{{name}}”
edit.lead: A new ref, packs folder or built-in replacement resets the last check: check the source again.

replace.title: Replace the archive of “{{name}}”
replace.lead: Check and apply the new archive. Versions already in the catalog stay.

remove.title: Remove “{{name}}”?
remove.lead: The source packs disappear from the project wizard. Versions stay in the store: existing projects keep working on them.
